Its nutty aroma has been amplified.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Acorns are a type of [[Roasted Food]], resulting from [[Acorn]]s that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} A Roasted Acorn is said to smell even more nutty than a normal Acorn. [[Link]] can heal half a [[Heart]] by eating a Roasted Acorn. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Acorns reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Acorn]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. A Roasted Acorn is said to smell even more nutty than a normal Acorn. [[Link]] can heal half a [[Heart]] by eating a Roasted Acorn. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Acorn * Food * Roasted Food * Roasted Tree Nut }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
